Soft clicks when you move around, select and go back.
Allow Prism to show your apps\' notifications here. If your TV has no Notification access setting, run once from a computer with ADB:\n\nadb shell cmd notification allow_listener %1$s
Apple TV aerials or your own photos and videos. Starts on the Home screen after the time below; to show it over other apps too, make Prism Aerials the TV\'s screen saver.
Choose which aerials you\'d like to see, including landscape, cityscape, underwater and Earth. With a download frequency set, new aerials download periodically and play without buffering.
The screen saver rotates through these aerials. Hide any you don\'t want included.
How often Prism downloads a new aerial to the TV (up to 3 are kept, about 0.5–0.9 GB). Stream Only plays them straight from Apple and stores nothing.
Plays the photos and videos in %1$s, the same folder used for wallpapers.
No photos or videos yet. Copy some to %1$s
Opens the TV\'s screen saver settings: choose Prism Aerials.

Some TVs hide the screen saver choice. From a computer with ADB debugging enabled on the TV, run:

adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %1$s
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_enabled 1

The TV then shows Prism Aerials whenever it would start its own screen saver.
Can\'t reach Apple\'s aerial videos. Check the internet connection.
Apple TV aerial videos as your wallpaper. Each one downloads once (about 100–500 MB). Clips you\'re not using are deleted 6 hours after you switch away; their previews stay.
Download failed. Check the connection and try again.
Avatars by DiceBear (CC0 styles). The picture is downloaded once and kept on this TV.
Prism replaces your TV\'s Home screen with a fast, ad-free, tvOS-style one. Set it as the default launcher so the Home button opens it.
Prism is your default launcher. The Home button opens it.
Home Button Still Opens the Old Launcher?

Some TVs (Google TV, TCL) always prefer their built-in launcher. From a computer on the same network, with ADB debugging enabled on the TV, run:

adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 %1$s

To undo:
adb shell pm enable %1$s

Prism (%2$s) then becomes the Home screen.
Prism %1$s\n\nA lightweight tvOS-inspired launcher. No background services, no tracking. Avatars: DiceBear (CC0). Gallery photos: Unsplash via Lorem Picsum.

Copy photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) or videos (MP4, WebM, MKV) to:
%1$s

For example: adb push clip.mp4 %1$s/
Videos play muted and loop, and pause while another app is open.
A fast, ad-free Home screen for your TV, inspired by Apple TV: a glass dock, a Top Shelf with each app\'s picks, and your own wallpapers.\n\nThis takes a minute: one step per screen.

Show what\'s on JioHotstar, Prime Video, YouTube and other apps right on the Top Shelf when you rest on them in the dock.\n\nPrism needs permission to read the recommendation rows these apps publish. Nothing leaves your TV.
So the Home button on your remote opens Prism. You can switch back any time from Settings → Default Launcher.

Pick a wallpaper (photos or videos), a profile picture, and tune the glass: blur, dim, gloss and refraction. Wallpaper gallery and avatars download over the internet.\n\nLong-press any app on Home to move it.
When you rest on an app in the dock, show that app\'s channel previews (its recommended movies and shows) with artwork, and let you open them directly.
Sets the effects below. Lower if Home stutters or restarts while you scroll.
The video wallpaper, glass refraction and focus glow cost the most graphics work. If Home stutters or restarts while you scroll, choose a lower quality.
Still wallpaper, plain dock glass, no focus glow. Lightest on the TV.
Video wallpaper and focus glow; the glass bends the backdrop only while nothing moves. Recommended.
Every effect at full quality, also while scrolling.
Keep the current effects and change them one by one in Appearance.
Play video wallpapers. Off: their still picture is shown instead.
How the dock glass bends the backdrop: always, only while nothing moves, or never.
Soft coloured glow behind the focused app.
